text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ingredients, check! Cooking utensils, 
check! Everything's ready, Ines-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get started! Making sweets 
packed full of heartfelt sincerity♪
...That looks kinda funのだ.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy was spotted in a corner of 
the cafeteria. She seemed to want to join 
in but lacked the courage, pacing back and 
forth in front of the kitchen for a while 
now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Yahoo, Windy-chan! Did you come by to 
see Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! W-Windy-chan is... Windy-chan just, 
um... c-c-c—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Came to play a prankのだ...!! I'm gonna 
mess with the hero, just like alwaysのだ!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wh-What did you say?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right now, we're making super important 
sweets to give to our friends! I won't let 
you ruin our sincerity or our sweets!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ughhh...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... Windy-chan is... Windy-chan is... 
ngh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Biko, you big dummy dummy! Hothead! 
Blehhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, Windy-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Windy-chan... Could it be that she 
actually wanted to make sweets with us?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When she ran off, she looked kind of 
lonely.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
She probably couldn't be honest with 
herself, so her words and her true 
feelings ended up all topsy-turvy.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Topsy-turvy...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. My little sisters went through a 
phase like that too~. And when that 
happens, you see—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta face them straightforwardly. 
If you do, their true feelings are sure to 
come to light!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...! Got it! Thank you, Senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
B-Biko?! Why did you chase after meのだ! 
Are you gonna lecture me again?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it! I came to apologize 
to you, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!!!!! When I heard "prank" I got 
heated up and didn't even check what you 
were really feeling, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even though you might have come to the 
kitchen because you wanted to make sweets 
too...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, won't you make them 
with us now?! I really wanna bake with 
you, Senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're way off baseのだ...! It's not 
like I wanted to join in at all, and 
making them together, what kind of joke—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally serious! It'll be way, way 
more fun if you're with us, Senpai!! Look 
into my eyes and believe me!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Urghhh—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—All fi~nished! Thanks to both of you, 
some wonderful sweets turned out great~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! For someone like Windy-chan, this is 
a piece of cakeのだ!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now all that's left is to go hand out our 
heartfelt presents to everyone! First off—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ines-senpai, Windy-senpai!! Please accept 
my feelings of gratitude!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?! You're giving... sweets to me?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's thanks for baking together with 
me!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~! Biko-chan's sincerity is 
packed to the brim in this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-I guess I have no choice but to accept 
itのだ! W-Well then, Windy-chan is heading 
backのだ!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chuckling that she'd secretly left some 
sweets behind, Shinko Windy walked off 
with a satisfied look. It seemed they had 
successfully bonded over sweets making.
